BiblicalUsage: Jekabtseel is a place in Palestine, a town of Judah in the south. In Nehemiah 11:25, at Jekabzeel, and in the villages thereof.
TheologicalSignificance: Jekabzeel holds its villages, and I believe this town matters because returned exiles made their homes there.
